                                                     SPARKLE Intel® Arc™ A310 Omni View, 4GB GDDR6, 4x HDMI, 50W TBP, Single

                                                     SPARKLE Intel Arc A310 Omni View provides 4x HDMI display output and reduces the power
                                                     consumption from 75W to 50W, provides great performance with lower heat and higher power
